text:
Auston Matthews spent last season grinding through 53 points in 60 games. This one looks different: 27 points in 19 games, 11 goals, and headlines from the Toronto Sun to The Big Lead about his health and his skating. The Leafs Nation calls it his career-best playmaking, and 16 assists back that up.

His own game is real. He's generating 1.51 expected goals per 60 (the quality of his chances), Toronto gets 55% of the 5v5 expected goals with him on, and our wins-added measure ranks him fourth of 506 skaters. What won't last is the finishing around him: the Leafs have scored 7.7 more goals than their chances deserve with Matthews out there, and his 19% shooting sits above his range. Our projection settles at 87 points.

The team is the worry. Toronto has lost three straight, the last a 4-0 shutout by New Jersey, and afterward a post from The Leafs Nation had Matthews saying the Leafs "need to look in the mirror and ask more of themselves." Watch whether the captain's line can carry them out of it.
headline: Matthews looks like Matthews again, with some help
